title: Joe Hendry: belief becomes a world championship
summary: Joe Hendry’s audience support becomes a sustained challenge for Nic Nemeth’s world title. A controversial Bound for Glory defeat delays the payoff until Genesis.

chapters.title: Hendry falls short at Bound for Glory
chapters.result: Nemeth retains against Hendry with Kazarian as special referee.
chapters.context: JBL’s intervention affects the finish, leaving Hendry’s supporters with a disputed outcome and an unfinished championship pursuit.

chapters.title: Hendry delivers the title victory
chapters.result: Joe Hendry defeats Nic Nemeth for the TNA world title.
chapters.context: The rematch converts Hendry’s popularity into a championship reign and pays off the chase that stalled at Bound for Glory.
